intervals.label: construction of the SIDDHARTA set-up
intervals.note: A 2007 plan: construction was to be finished in spring 2007 and the set-up installed at DAΦNE in 2007. The data were taken in 2009 (after DAΦNE's interaction-region changes of 2007-2008, arXiv:0803.1450), so the end of construction is taken as the start of data taking (year precision); no source fetched dates the installation.
intervals.quote: The construction phase started in the second half of 2006 and will be finished in spring 2007.

intervals.label: DAΦNE data taking (kaonic hydrogen, helium and deuterium)
intervals.locator: SIDDHARTA kaonic hydrogen paper (Phys. Lett. B 704, 2011), Section 2
intervals.note: Year precision; six months of data in 2009, the kaonic deuterium data in October 2009 (arXiv:1302.2797). The months of the six-month run are not given in the sources fetched.
intervals.quote: Data were accumulated over six months in 2009 with integrated luminosities of ∼ 340 pb−1 for the hydrogen and ∼ 100 pb−1 for the deuterium measurement.

intervals.label: data taking ended
intervals.note: Year precision; the end of the programme is inferred: the measurements 'were carried out in 2009' (past tense) and the apparatus was succeeded by SIDDHARTA-2, which no source dates before 2018.
intervals.quote: The most precise kaonic hydrogen measurement to-date, together with an exploratory measurement of kaonic deuterium, were carried out in 2009 by the SIDDHARTA collaboration

intervals.label: kaonic deuterium run
intervals.quote: The kaonic deuterium data were collected in October 2009, for a total integrated luminosity of about 100 pb−1.

summary.plain: The collaboration, with institutes in Italy, Canada, Romania, Austria, Japan and Germany, that built and ran the SIDDHARTA kaonic-atom experiment at Frascati's DAΦNE.
summary.technical: SIDDHARTA Collaboration: 37 authors on the 2011 kaonic hydrogen paper (arXiv listing), from INFN-LNF, Victoria, Politecnico di Milano, IFIN-HH Magurele, the Stefan Meyer Institute Vienna, INFN Roma and Istituto Superiore di Sanità, Tokyo, RIKEN and TU Munich. Membership list not retrieved.
